title: Among male patients with normal creatinine levels and no thrombosis, find t
question: Among male patients with normal creatinine levels and no thrombosis, find the one with the highest anti-Cardiolipin IgA concentration. If there’s a tie, choose the oldest patient (earliest birthday). Return their ID.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND T3."XCL_056" IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(T3."XCL_056" AS REAL) < 1.5
  AND T2."XCL_013" = 0
ORDER BY T3."XCL_024" DESC, T1."XCL_060" ASC
LIMIT 1
